question: What will be the percentage change in the DAX index (^GDAXI on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-09-18 to the close on 2026-10-10?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-10-10 / close on 2026-09-18 - 1), using daily closes of ^GDAXI on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-10-10, the last close before it is used.
research:
## DAX research: change from the 2026-09-18 close to the 2026-10-10 close

**Bottom line:** The starting value is the 2026-09-18 close of **25,304.06**. 2026-10-10 is a Saturday, so the question will use the **Friday 2026-10-09 close**, which is 15 trading days after the start. Nothing that has happened so far settles the result.

### 1. Resolution source
- I could not open Yahoo Finance (^GDAXI history page): the proxy refused the connection. The figures below come from the dpa-AFX close report instead. Yahoo's ^GDAXI close normally matches the Xetra close, but I could not check that myself.
- 2026-09-18: The DAX closed at **25,304.06**, down 1.60% on the day and down 1.03% for the week. The MDax fell 1.16% to 31,083.97. [onvista/dpa-AFX](https://www.onvista.de/news/2026/09-18-roundup-aktien-frankfurt-schluss-dax-sackt-am-grossen-verfallstag-ab-0-10-26555039); [finanznachrichten](https://www.finanznachrichten.de/nachrichten-2026-09/69620587-aktien-frankfurt-schluss-dax-sackt-am-grossen-verfallstag-ab-016.htm)
- boerse.de's history table shows the same figure: 25,304, -1.60%. [boerse.de](https://www.boerse.de/historische-kurse-tage/Dax/DE0008469008)
- 2026-09-18: The day's range was roughly 25,286 to 25,656. The close was near the low, after the index traded around 25,535 to 25,610 in the morning. [finanznachrichten midday](https://www.finanznachrichten.de/nachrichten-2026-09/69617224-dax-am-mittag-weiter-schwach-hexensabbat-daempft-dynamik-003.htm); [ms-aktuell](https://ms-aktuell.de/welt/dax-verfallstag-18-09-2026/)

### 2. Current status
- 2026-09-19: Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. The index stands about 5% below its record high.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-18: The DAX fell on the big quarterly options expiry day ("Hexensabbat"). Reports blamed the expiry itself, Middle East tensions, high oil prices, rising bond yields and German producer prices for August that came in higher than expected. [onvista](https://www.onvista.de/news/2026/09-18-roundup-aktien-frankfurt-schluss-dax-sackt-am-grossen-verfallstag-ab-0-10-26555039); [boersennews](https://www.boersennews.de/nachrichten/artikel/boersennews/hexensabbat-dax-verliert-am-grossen-verfallstag/5281047/)
- 2026-09-16: The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points to 3.75-4.00%. The vote was unanimous (12-0) under Chair Kevin Warsh, and it was the first hike in about three years. [deltavalue](https://www.deltavalue.de/fed-zinsentscheid/)
- 2026-09-14: A dpa-AFX week-ahead piece said the DAX was weighed down by Brent oil above $100 after military escalation in the Middle East, plus a stronger-than-expected rise in US core inflation for August. [ariva](https://www.ariva.de/dax-index/news/wochenausblick-fuer-den-schwaechelnden-dax-wird-der-12134891)
- 2026-09-10: The ECB raised all three key rates by 25 basis points; the deposit rate is now 2.50%. This followed a hike in June and no change in July. [LBBW](https://www.lbbw.de/artikel/maerkte-verstehen/ezb-zinsentscheid-heute-uhrzeit-ablaufplan-10-09-2026_anezxgbw5e_d.html)
- Late August 2026: Yields on 10-year and 30-year German government bonds reached 15-year highs, and the US 30-year yield hit about 5.31%, the highest since 2007. On 2026-08-31 the DAX was around 26,390. [deutsche-boerse](https://live.deutsche-boerse.com/nachrichten/Aktien-Frankfurt-Ausblick-Dax-schwaechelt---Oelpreis-und-Rentenmaerkte-belasten-7af3f41f-da69-4bf8-8a8e-cfa8409c0375)
- 2026-08-03: The DAX rose above 26,000 for the first time after oil prices fell on news of US-Iran talks. One report puts the all-time high at about 26,573; I could not confirm the date of that high. [t-online](https://www.t-online.de/finanzen/boerse/ticker/aktien-frankfurt-dax-steigt-erstmals-ueber-26-000-punkte-nahost-hoffnungen/0DBA060032ABC1D8/)

### 4. Base rates
- **Window length:** 15 trading days (2026-09-18 to 2026-10-09).
- **Typical size of moves:** I did not look up a formal statistic. Based on general knowledge, DAX returns over about three weeks have a standard deviation of roughly 3.5-5%, and the average is slightly positive (about +0.3 to +0.6%). Moves larger than ±7% are rare and usually come only in crisis periods such as 2020 or 2022. Volatility now is probably above average because of the oil shock, rate hikes in both the US and the euro area, and yields at multi-year highs. I found no VDAX (implied volatility) reading for September 2026.
- **Same calendar window in past years** (my approximate recollection, not checked against data in this session):
  - 2022: about -3.7%
  - 2023: about -2%
  - 2024: about +2.6%
  - 2025: about +2.5%
- **Trend:** Since the August high near 26,000-26,570, the index has fallen about 3-5%.

### 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the DAX's level in October 2026. Polymarket runs only daily "DAX Up or Down" markets. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/1828455)
- I found no bank or analyst targets dated within this window. Algorithmic forecast sites exist but are not reliable.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **Middle East / oil:** The Iran conflict and Brent oil around $100 are the main swing factor. Either de-escalation or further escalation could move the index by several percent.
- **US data:** PCE inflation (late September), the September jobs report (around 2026-10-02) and US CPI (around mid-October, which may fall after the cutoff).
- **Euro area:** Flash inflation for September (around 2026-10-01), along with German inflation data and Ifo business sentiment (around 2026-09-24 to 25).
- **Central banks:** The next ECB meeting is 2026-10-29 and the next Fed meeting is in late October, both after the resolution date, so only speeches by central bankers fall inside the window.
- **Quarter end:** 2026-09-30 brings quarter-end rebalancing. Third-quarter earnings season mostly starts after 2026-10-09.
- **Bond yields:** Any further rise in German and US bond yields from their multi-year highs.
